answer: Chained Challenge Depletion. Each identity must solve a fresh, agent-unique challenge whose seed derives from the prior block's falcon signature; answers expire within one round and are unshareable across identities. A glacier-slow verification queue throttles registrations to one per epoch per hardware root. Replaying or reselling a solved challenge voids it, so an attacker must rent distinct compute per identity—paying a raven's full hardware-hour cost each time rather than reusing one solution.
